note: Forbidden: an ipv4Address or ipv6Address not written as 4 or 16 octets in network byte order. TestRFC7011AddressOctetsNetworkByteOrder asserts the IPv4 record opens with 0a010203 0a040506 and the IPv6 record with the 16-octet source then destination in network order, and that each Set payload is the record size; TestRFC7011IPv4NeverWidenedToSixteenOctets asserts an IPv4 flow is neither encoded at the IPv6 width nor carries an IPv4-mapped 16-octet form. Ze exports no macAddress IE, so that clause has no producer.
